_comment: Gzip-kB ceilings for app-owned client chunks — the perf-decomposition targets. Catches a regression (e.g. a heavy module statically re-imported into app._index, the Move-1 issue). Raise a budget deliberately, in the same PR, when a growth is intended. Vendor chunks (Polaris/React) are not tracked here — their size is a dependency choice, not a regression.
